digest.component_or_area: ADR (Architecture Decision Record) management and indexing
propositions: ADR numbering collisions exist: 91 files across 69 distinct numbers with 17 duplicate numbers (0007, 0008-0012, 0015-0016, 0026, 0031-0032, 0035-0037, 0038, 0040-0041 duplicated), requiring 22 files to be renumbered
Per-number marker files (docs/adr/.numbers/NNNN with content = filename) prevent future collisions via git add/add conflicts, replacing racy CI checks
Renumbering resolves collisions by keeping earliest-landed ADR at original number and moving 22 duplicate ADRs to 0070-0091 in ascending landing-date order
Cross-references to moved ADRs must be rewritten to their new numbers; slug-bearing references are disambiguated and rewritten, bare numbers are recorded with resolution tier or marked UNRESOLVED
CI gate (check_adr_numbers.py) enforces bijection between ADRs and markers, unique numbers, and referential integrity of all adr/NNNN-slug links in docs/
Generated index (docs/adr/README.md) and renumbering map (docs/adr/RENUMBERING.md) document the resolution and serve as authoritative reference for old-to-new mapping
